violations.why: The ISR can preempt main between the copy at line 46 and the check at line 83 and change the value, so the two reads see different values.
The ISR can change the value after the >=16 check at line 83 and before the value is passed as an argument at line 85, so the check no longer holds.
The ISR can write between the argument read at line 85 and the re-read in func_2 at line 65, so func_2 can see a different value.
